page.layout: One printed page: running text in one main column with a column of year numbers to the left of it; marginal notes (reference marks) in the right margin. Running head at top. Page number at top left of the text block.

main_text.p: Dauid nafcitur. Eft enim annorum 30, cùm in Hebron vnctus fuit. 2. Sam.5.v.4. Hâc in re fuit typus Christi, qui anno 30. completo baptizatus eft.f

Saul,ē tribuBeniamin,vngitur in regem Israël. 1.Sam.13.v.1. Atq; hîc definit regimen iudicum, quod durauit annos 386. Perperam huc trahuntur 300. anni Iud.11.verf.28:quia illi incipiunt ab exitu ex Ægypto, vnde Iephthe narrationis suæ initium fecerat verf.18. Præcise autem numerat annos 300, numero rotundo siue completo.10
Saul duobus annis exactis reiicitur, & Dauid 11 inungitur. 1.Sam.13.v.1.&16.v.14.
Saul perit, anno regni 10:cum quo concurrit quadragesimus Samuelis, qui ipse tum quoque 20 obiit. 1.Sam.25.
Dauid,filius Isai, regnat annos 40. 2.Sam.5.v.4. Secundo vngitur Saule occiso,in Hebron,& tertio quoque. 2.Sam.2.v.4. In Hebron regnat annos 7.menf. 6. Hierosolymis,an.33. 2.Sam.1.25
Dauid Philiftæos vincit, & arcam Domini reducit, quæ ad 50.annos fuerat in domo Aminadab.2.Sam.6.
Dauid se polluit adulterio & homicidio: quâ de causâ reprehenditur à Nathane. 2.Sam.11.12.
Thamar stupratur vi à fratre Amnone. 2.Sa-muelis13.35
Amnon interficitur ab Absalomo, qui postea fugit.

page.notes: Year numbers in the left column (2860, 2868, 2879, 2881, 2885, 2887, 2888, 2889, 2900, 2902, 2903, 2906, 2911, 2912, 2914) are the chronology column and are not transcribed as text. Marginal reference marks (f, 10, 11, 20, 25, 30, 35) are printed as small numerals/signs beside the text; their matching notes are not legible as separate text. Some words are uncertain in the scan ("Hierosolymis", "Thamar", "Dauid" spelling) and are printed as seen. The text "Saul,ē" and "anno regni 10" may be imperfectly read. Right-hand edge is partly dark.
